row.notes: Reads the screen name argument (func 0x144184950), looks its hash up in the screen system robin-hood map (+0x98 multiplier, +0xa0 entries, +0xa8 info, +0xb8 mask). Missing: returns "No screen called %hs exists". Found: reads an optional 0x13-char named argument and, if it equals string 0x145614a6a, a 0xd-char named argument passed to func 0x144184ad0(screen, value, 0); then calls Vm_Open_Screen(opener, screen) and returns the global OK string (0x146ca7590) or "Screen %hs failed to open because of %d". Good hook point to log or redirect screen opens.
